heading: How I work
intro: Three steps from your footage to a finished file.

steps.title: Brief
steps.body: You send footage, references and the target platform. I reply with a timeline and a fixed quote.

steps.title: Edit
steps.body: A rough cut to agree on story and pacing, then color, sound, captions and motion graphics.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.body: Final files exported for each platform, with agreed revisions included.
